signed_residual_definition: vertical ground-frame residual in mm, not orthogonal point-to-plane distance

metric_definitions.pair_correlation: unique frame pairs with common v support >= 100
metric_definitions.median_residual_std_mm: median per-v cross-frame std for sample_count >= 10
metric_definitions.sign_mixing_fraction: fraction of well-supported rows whose positive-residual fraction is in [0.35, 0.65]
metric_definitions.region_std: median per-v cross-frame std in fixed image bands for sample_count >= 2

apparent_tilt_warning: self-fit apparent tilt is derived from narrow-band reconstructed points and is not checkerboard mechanical tilt

fixed_ground_z0_source.origin: intersection of camera principal axis and checkerboard pattern plane
fixed_ground_z0_source.Zg_definition: checkerboard reference-plane normal toward camera; positive for protrusions
fixed_ground_z0_source.reason: The checkerboard pattern surface explicitly defines Zg=0, and its camera-frame plane transforms numerically to that ground-frame plane.
